title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kyle Trask signs with Panthers
items.desc: The Carolina Panthers signed QB Kyle Trask.
items.impact: Trask will add depth in the Panthers quarterback room with Haynes King (hamstring) week-to-week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Downs (groin) not practicing Sunday
items.desc: Josh Downs remained absent from practice on Sunday.
items.impact: Downs misses practice for a second straight day due to a groin injury. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Xavier Legette (stinger) back at practice Sunday
items.desc: Xavier Legette returned to practice at Panthers training camp on Sunday.
items.impact: Legette suffered the injury in practice on Tuesday. He will be competing for an immediate starting role in 3-WR sets.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dillon Radunz to miss season with torn ACL
items.desc: Saints OG Dillon Radunz suffered a torn ACL.
items.impact: Radunz suffered the injury during practice on Saturday. He appeared in 15 games last season, starting 10 of them. He was slated to be in a depth role on the offensive line for New Orleans this season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bryce Young, starters to play in preseason opener
items.desc: Bryce Young and the starters will play in the Panthers preseason opener against the Bills on Saturday.
items.impact: We will get our first look at the Panthers starting offense this season. They likely won't play more than a couple of offensive series give or take.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Luke Altmyer to play heavy snaps in preseason opener
items.desc: Luke Altmyer is expected to play heavy snaps in the Lions preseason opener against the Bengals.
items.impact: Altmyer signed with Detroit as an undrafted free agent this year. He is competing for a depth role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jared Goff will not play in preseason opener
items.desc: Jared Goff won't be playing in the preseason opener against Cincinnati this week.
items.impact: While Goff won't be playing, head coach Dan Campbell said he may play some starters in the second preseason game against the Commanders.

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.title: Teddy Bridgewater stepping away from Lions
items.desc: Teddy Bridgewater is stepping away from the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: Lions head coach Dan Campbell announced the news on Sunday, sharing a heartfelt message about Bridgewater as well. The quarterback has stepped away from the sport previously, but it seems like a retirement announcement could be next. Luke Altmyer is the current backup QB in Detroit.

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.title: Tucker Kraft (knee) returns to practice
items.desc: Tucker Kraft returned to practice on Sunday as he continues to rehab from a torn ACL.
items.impact: Kraft is back on the field and running routes as he ramps up from the ACL injury he suffered last season. The tight end is eyeing a Week 1 return, but his practice activity should be closely monitored throughout training camp.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jadarian Price (leg) not practicing Saturday, not considered serious
items.desc: Jadarian Price is missing practice for a second consecutive day on Saturday.
items.impact: Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald said Price has leg soreness. He is expected back on the field in a few days.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Laremy Tunsil (torn triceps) to undergo surgery, miss majority of season
items.desc: Commanders LT Laremy Tunsil suffered a torn triceps that will likely require surgery and will force him to miss at least a significant portion of the regular season.
items.impact: Tunsil suffered the injury in practice on Saturday during 1-on-1 pass-rush drills. It is a brutal break for Jayden Daniels and the Commanders offensive line and offense.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Haynes King (hamstring) week-to-week
items.desc: Panthers rookie QB Haynes King is week-to-week with a hamstring injury.
items.impact: King was the hero of the Hall of Fame game as he scored the winning touchdown on the very last play. He was expected to compete for the backup job with Kenny Pickett. He'll be sidelined for at least one week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cam Skattebo practices Saturday
items.desc: Cam Skattebo participated in Saturday's practice.
items.impact: Raanan noted that Skattebo was limited, but seemed fine. He left practice early on Friday following a collision, but it had appeared to be precautionary.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Maxx Crosby not practicing Saturday due to violating team rules
items.desc: Raiders HC Klint Kubiak told reporters that Maxx Crosby is being held out of practice Saturday for violating team rules for fighting.
items.impact: Crosby and Kirk Cousins got into it during practice on Friday. They should be back on the field in the next day or two.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kirk Cousins not practicing Saturday due to violating team rules
items.desc: Raiders HC Klint Kubiak told reporters that QB Kirk Cousins is being held out of practice Saturday for violating team rules for fighting.
items.impact: Cousins and Maxx Crosby got into it during practice on Friday. They should be back on the field in the next day or two.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Makai Lemon (hamstring) misses practice Saturday
items.desc: Makai Lemon remained absent from practice on Saturday due to a hamstring injury.
items.impact: Lemon has now missed several days due to a hamstring injury. He was at least able to catch some passes from the JUGS machine on Saturday. It's not ideal for the rookie to be missing several days of training camp, but it's still early.

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.title: Lane Johnson likely to retire after 2026 season
items.desc: Lane Johnson announced that the 2026 season will "potentially, probably" be the last of his career.
items.impact: While Johnson did not 100% commit to retiring after the upcoming season, it looks like that is the most likely outcome. The 36-year-old is a six-time Pro Bowler and played in 10 games last season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) not practicing Saturday
items.desc: DeVonta Smith is still not practicing on Saturday.
items.impact: Smith is still not being pushed back into practice off a hamstring injury. He remains day-to-day.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DJ Giddens (hamstring) not practicing Saturday
items.desc: DJ Giddens did not practice on Saturday.
items.impact: Giddens is competing for a depth role in the Colts backfield. It is not ideal timing for him up be missing several days of training camp.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Luther Burden III (leg) leaves practice with trainer Saturday
items.desc: Luther Burden III left practice with a trainer on Saturday.
items.impact: Burden limped off the field after he got tangled with a defender and fell awkwardly during a one-on-one red zone drill. There will be an update provided on his status when available.

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.title: Zay Flowers (quad contusion) considered day-to-day
items.desc: Zay Flowers suffered a left quad contusion at Saturday's practice and is now viewed as day-to-day.
items.impact: Flowers limped off the practice field under his own power on Saturday, and it looks like he avoided any serious injury following a collision. The 25-year-old is fresh off the best season of his career and a 4-year extension with Baltimore.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jared Bartlett waived by Jaguars
items.desc: The Jaguars waived linebacker Jared Bartlett with an injury designation.
items.impact: Bartlett will figure to seek another opportunity when he is cleared.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jahlani Tavai signs with Jaguars
items.desc: The Jaguars signed LB Jahlani Tavai.
items.impact: Tavai was released by the Patriots in March. He totaled 42 tackles and a forced fumble in 12 games with seven starts last season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jeadyn Lukus signs with Browns
items.desc: The Browns signed CB Jeadyn Lukus.
items.impact: Lukus will compete for a depth role in the secondary for Cleveland.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jack Conley re-signs with Browns
items.desc: The Browns re-signed OL Jack Conley.
items.impact: Conley will add depth on the offensive line for Cleveland.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kendrick Green placed on IR
items.desc: The Browns placed OL Kendrick Green on injured reserve.
items.impact: Green will likely be sidelined for the upcoming season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Reid Carrico waived by Browns
items.desc: The Browns waived LB Reid Carrico.
items.impact: Carrico will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jamari Thrash waived by Browns
items.desc: The Browns waived WR Jamari Thrash with injury designation.
items.impact: Thrash will seek another opportunity when he is cleared.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: De'Shawn Rucker waived by Lions
items.desc: The Lions have waived injured CB De'Shawn Rucker.
items.impact: Rucker will seek another opportunity when he is cleared.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ben Stille signs with Lions
items.desc: The Lions signed DE Ben Stille.
items.impact: Stille ended last season on the Falcons' practice squad. He will compete for a depth role on the Lions defensive line.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joseph Vaughn waived by Seahawks
items.desc: The Seahawks waived LB Joseph Vaughn.
items.impact: Vaugn will figure to seek another opportunity. Power Echols was signed as the corresponding move.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Power Echols signs with Seahawks
items.desc: The Seahawks signed LB Power Echols.
items.impact: Echols spent time with the Bears and Texans last season. He did not appear in a regular season game.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Daniel Rickert signs with Rams
items.desc: The Rams signed DE Daniel Rickert.
items.impact: Rickert will compete for a depth role on the Rams defensive line.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: A.T. Perry waived by Steelers
items.desc: The Steelers waived WR A.T. Perry.
items.impact: Perry will figure to seek another opportunity. The Steelers claimed WR Colton Dowell off waivers as the corresponding move.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: JJ Galbreath waived by Steelers
items.desc: The Steelers waived TE JJ Galbreath.
items.impact: Galbreath will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp. They claimed TE Lance Mason as the corresponding move.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: William Bradley-King reaches injury settlement with 49ers
items.desc: The 49ers reached an injury settlement to part ways with DE William Bradley-King.
items.impact: Bradley-King had cleared waivers and reverted to the 49ers injured reserve.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Colton Dowell claimed off waivers by Steelers
items.desc: The Steelers claimed WR Colton Dowell off waivers.
items.impact: Dowell was waived by the 49ers. He will compete for a depth role in the Steelers wide receiver room.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Lance Mason claimed off waivers by Steelers
items.desc: The Steelers claimed TE Lance Mason off waivers.
items.impact: Mason was waived by the Seahawks. He will compete for a depth role in the Steelers right end room.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brenden Jaimes signs with Giants
items.desc: The Giants signed C Brenden Jaimes.
items.impact: Jaimes will provide depth for the Giants with John Michael Schmitz likely headed to the concussion protocol.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jarrick Bernard-Converse waived by Giants
items.desc: The Giants waived CB Jarrick Bernard-Converse with an injury designation.
items.impact: Bernard-Converse had been dealing with a knee injury and hadn't practice in several days. He'll figure to seek another opportunity when he is cleared.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Omar Brown waived by Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins waived/injured safety Omar Brown.
items.impact: Brown will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp when he is cleared.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mark Gronowski waived by Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins waived QB Mark Gronowski.
items.impact: Gronkowski will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ahmari Harvey claimed off waivers by Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins claimed CB Ahmari Harvey off waivers.
items.impact: Harvey was waived by the Steelers. He will compete for a depth role in the Dolphins corner back room.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tanner Wall signs with Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins signed S Tanner Wall.
items.impact: Wall will compete in training camp for a depth role in the Dolphins secondary.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zach Harrison activated from NFI list
items.desc: The Falcons activated Zach Harrison from the non-football injury list.
items.impact: Harrison has been cleared to practice after missing the start of training camp.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Deion Jones signs with Saints
items.desc: The Saints signed LB Deion Jones.
items.impact: Jones will compete for a depth role in the Saints linebacker room.

items.desc: The Cowboys waived Dominic Richardson.
items.impact: Richardson will seek another opportunity during training camp.
